Geospatial * WIP: End-to-end spatial file pruning from Spark SQL, ST_INTERSECTS pushdown (#17175) — DRAFT, now carries a stale label; last touched Aug 13. The discussion explores using derived (virtual) columns to represent non-materialized fields in Iceberg v4, leveraging sort order and cluster specifications to index and prune data. The discussion highlights an alternative using the SnapshotAncestryValidator hook introduced in 1.11 for conflict detection, and explains the use case of embedding a proprietary index into a statistics file.
